scope.description: One node restarted over identical stores after it had committed a configuration whose entry was never written.
assumptions: the same LogStore, StableStore, SnapshotStore and transport are reused with a fresh FSM
no fault is injected into the restart itself
excluded: an FSM that already applied entries under the lost configuration
behaviour of peers that never learned the adopted configuration

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: one LogStore wrapper fails exactly one StoreLogs call; no target source is replaced
the restarted instance reuses the same LogStore, StableStore, SnapshotStore and transport as the original, with a fresh FSM
timeouts are shortened and the log level is raised to ERROR so the sequence completes quickly

plan_uncertainties: The check observes one restart of one node; whether an FSM that already applied entries under the lost configuration is affected is a separate question.
grounding_unresolved: Interaction with an FSM state that was applied before the restart
Whether a restarted node that still holds an applied FSM state inconsistent with the re-derived configuration is affected is not exercised.

boundaries: an FSM that already applied entries under the lost configuration
